title: Event Fee Recompute
description: Recomputes event-contract trading fees per fill and per order from an effective-dated venue fee profile, and diffs the recompute against a caller-reported fee (MATCH | OVERCHARGE | UNDERCHARGE). Venue-neutral: the fee family and its parameters are data - parabolic, multiplier, linear, flat, rebate_share, combo - with shipped effective-dated profile rows for Kalshi (per-fill ceil to $0.000001 plus the pinned per-order rounding accumulator), Polymarket global (pinned category rate table, 5-decimal rounding with the 0.00001 USDC minimum floor) and Polymarket US (CFTC 40.6(d) taker theta 0.06 from 2026-07-07, 0.0695 from 2026-09-17, pinned combo curve from 2026-09-25), plus a caller-declared generic profile whose rows mirror Kalshi GET /series/fee_changes. Integer BigInt arithmetic only; no float in any fee path. Identifier-like labels are refused, never echoed.

profile.description: Shipped profile id, or generic to declare every parameter from the caller. Any other string is refused.

as_of.description: ISO calendar date selecting the effective profile row.

category.description: polymarket_global only: market category (crypto, sports, finance, politics, economics, culture, weather, other, mentions, tech, combos). Defaults to other.

balance_precision_micro.description: kalshi only: the member balance grid in micro-dollars. 10000 = non-direct ($0.01, default), 100 = direct ($0.0001).

params.description: generic only: fee_family (parabolic, multiplier, linear, flat, rebate_share, combo), theta_taker_num/den, optional theta_maker_num/den, series_multiplier_num/den, rebate_share_bp, flat_fee_micro, fill_rounding_unit_micro, order_rounding_unit_micro, rounding_mode (ceil | round_half_up), optional floor_min_fee_micro, optional accumulator, or rows[] of effective-dated parameter rows.

order_label.description: Opaque synthetic label. Values that look like an account id, order id, address or hash are refused and never echoed.

kind.description: Defaults to standard. Combo orders carry legs[].

outcomes.description: Two or more opaque outcome labels declaring a multi-outcome market.

price_micro.description: Integer price in micro-dollars of par (1e-6 USD).

legs.description: Combo-order legs, each with its own fills.

reported_fee_minor.description: Optional caller-reported order fee in micro-dollars; the diff verdict MATCH | OVERCHARGE | UNDERCHARGE is returned per order.

orders.description: Orders to recompute. At most 500 fills total across the call. Aggregate only: no account or order identifiers.

input_schema.description: Profile selection with as_of, plus at least one order of synthetic labelled fills.
